items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: They emanated from such places as Frank Dailey's Meadowbrook

ctx.x: That was these radio spots -- what were they? Late on Saturday night, the radio spots?

Well, I guess they were Saturday nights. You know, they called them Transcontinental broadcasts, you know, remotes, as they called them in those days. They emanated from such places as Frank Dailey's Meadowbrook and all of those ... I think that was the name of it, wasn't it?
